track_width_note: UNMEASURED. Wheel centre-to-centre separation. Needed for heading and turning; straight-line distance is unaffected. Measure it and set it before trusting odometry yaw.
encoder_sign_note: RPWM (forward) makes the counters run negative.
direction_note: Per wheel: which way the motor turns for a positive command, relative to the bot's forward. The two motors are mounted mirror-imaged, so wiring both the same makes one run backwards. -1 flips both the duty sent and the counts read for that wheel, so forward is forward on both sides everywhere above the driver. Verify with motor_tui.py: press w, both wheels roll forward and both angles climb.
gear_ratio_note: Measured with gear_check.py by driving the wheel a whole number of revolutions under power and reading the tyre mark. This supersedes the per-wheel hand-turned figures, which are biased low by gearbox backlash. ONE ratio applies to both wheels -- they share a gearbox design, so a per-wheel difference is measurement error, and baking it in makes the car curve.
